desc:
Welcome to a Wooden Train Sandbox Game where you design and build your own railway layouts from the ground up.

Connect straight and curved track pieces to create anything you can think of! Use pillars to raise your track high into the air and bridges to carry them over each other.

Add stations, scenery and buildings to turn your tracks into a complete train map with its own little world around it.

Game is in testing stage, will be buggy but you are welcome to try it.
